summary: Feed s165_triple is degraded: 59% of TCP sessions are one-way, required VLAN 20 is missing (31% untagged), and 66.6% encrypted traffic exceeds IDS 60% tolerance.

findings.root_cause: Packet broker is delivering only one direction of TCP flows to this IDS port - RX and TX from TAP/SPAN or upstream links are split across different tool ports and not aggregated, or asymmetric routing means only one side is tapped. 102 of 173 sessions (59.0%) are unidirectional, well above 10% threshold.
findings.impact_on_tool: IDS needs_both_directions=true for stateful TCP reassembly and signature matching; with one-way traffic it cannot track handshakes, misses request/response attack patterns, and creates incomplete flow records.

recommended_fix.why: Aggregate both directions of each flow to the same IDS port (combine RX/TX TAP feeds or both sides of asymmetric path) so IDS sees bidirectional sessions for full state tracking.

findings.root_cause: Required VLAN 20 is completely absent and 31% of packets arrive untagged, indicating VLAN tags are being stripped upstream - typically SPAN configured to remove tags or packet broker stripping 802.1Q / not trunking VLANs 10 and 20 to this tool port.
findings.impact_on_tool: IDS requires VLANs [10,20] for segment-aware detection; loss of VLAN 20 means zero coverage for that segment and untagged traffic loses tenant/context, breaking VLAN-based policies.

recommended_fix.why: Configure TAP/SPAN and packet broker to preserve and forward 802.1Q tags for VLANs 10 and 20 to the IDS so segmentation context is restored.

findings.root_cause: 66.6% of bytes are encrypted (TLS) exceeding the IDS tolerance of 60%; traffic is increasingly opaque and IDS has no payload visibility without decryption.
findings.impact_on_tool: IDS needs_full_payload=true for signature matching; with two-thirds encrypted it is blind to exploits, C2 and exfiltration inside TLS, sharply reducing detection efficacy to metadata only.

recommended_fix.why: Add selective TLS decryption at packet broker or forward copy to decryption zone before IDS, or tune IDS to use encrypted-traffic analytics (JA3/JA4) if decryption not possible.
